name: Yellow Cardinal
rangeDescription: Far southeastern brazil and uruguay to northern argentina
description: Striking yellow and black songbird. Note the black pointed crest.

name: White-faced Redstart
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southern venezuela (cerros guany, yaví, and paraque)
description: Striking warbler known only from Cerro Sipapo, Cerro Guanay, and Cerro Yaví, which are very remote tepuis (table mountains) in south central Venezuela. They are so hard to access that very few birders or ornithologists have ever seen this species.

name: Horned Coot
rangeDescription: High andean lakes of southwestern bolivia to northern chile and northwestern argentina
description: Very large, but rather local coot; rare except at a few lakes in the high Andes set amid barren and rocky surroundings. Often far out on deep-water lakes, where it looks rather uneventful: black overall with a pale yellowish bill.

name: Eastern Marsh Harrier
rangeDescription: Eastern asia; winters to southeastern asia, philippines, and indonesia
description: A common patroller above reedbeds, flying with wings raised in a shallow V-shape. Adult males are predominantly pale gray with a dark-speckled head, blackish back with pale-edged feathers, and black wingtips.

name: Northern Parula
rangeDescription: Eastern north america (southern canada to southern usa); winters to nicaragua and west indies
description: Small, short-tailed warbler with a sharply pointed, bicolored bill. Blue-gray above with mossy-green patch on the back, white eye-arcs, and yellow breast.

name: Gray-headed Albatross
rangeDescription: Circumpolar high southern latitudes; ranges southern oceans north to 35°s
description: Rarely found north of cold subantarctic waters; ranges south to pack-ice in summer. Adult has a gray head, thick black underwing margins like much commoner Black-browed Albatross.

name: Eastern Long-tailed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Benin through congo basin to western uganda and northern angola
description: A small-bodied hornbill with an extremely long tail, a dark bill, and a puffy white crest. Usually found in thick rainforest, where it can be difficult to view.

name: Venezuelan Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Coastal cordillera of northern venezuela (southern lara eastward to miranda)
description: Small, drab tyrannulet with limited range in northern Venezuela. Fairly inconspicuous; usually found as singles or pairs in middle to upper levels of forests, plantations, and second-growth.

name: Sri Lanka Blue-Magpie
rangeDescription: Dense evergreen hill forest of sri lanka
description: A large, long-tailed blue bird with a white-tipped tail, and chestnut hood and wings. Inhabits humid forest from lowlands to hills, where it often accompanies mixed canopy flocks, either singly or in small groups.

name: Philippine Pied-Fantail
rangeDescription: Philippines and sulu archipelago
description: A medium-sized, long-tailed bird of wooded and fairly open areas in the lowlands. Sooty-gray above and white below, with a black chest band and black face.

name: Mountain Thornbill
rangeDescription: Rainforest of northeastern queensland (cooktown to paluma range)
description: Small bird with thin pointed bill found in middle- to high-elevation rainforests in far northern Queensland. Greenish gray above, pale below, with faint streaks on chest, pale eye, and faint pale speckling on gray forecrown.

name: Grant's Bluebill
rangeDescription: Primary forest of eastern democratic republic of the congo and southwestern uganda
description: A large, chunky-headed black-and-red forest waxbill with a blue-and-red bill. Sexes differ: the male has a red forehead extending to the midcrown and eyes that appear to be rimmed by black spectacles, while the female has white spots on the belly and red only on the throat and rump.

name: Orange-eyed Flatbill
rangeDescription: Tropical southern colombia and northeastern peru north of the amazon
description: Rare flycatcher found in seasonally flooded swamp forest in lowlands east of the Andes. Pale eye, wide bill, buffy throat and breast, gray crown, and lack of facial markings help separate it from similar species such as Gray-crowned Flycatcher.

name: Pale Thrush
rangeDescription: Northeastern siberia to kuril islands and japan; winters to southeastern asia and sumatra
description: Although not actually pale, this brownish songbird is one of the plainer thrushes in its range. Found in areas of open woodland and scrubland; less tied to extensive forests than other thrushes, particularly in the winter, when it may often be found near reedbeds and in thickets.

name: Yellow-billed Loon
rangeDescription: Northern eurasia and northern north america; winters to northern baja california
description: A large, heavy-billed loon of the High Arctic. Much like a Common Loon but with a thicker neck and blockier head.

name: Black-headed Bunting
rangeDescription: South-central eurasia; winters to india
description: Large, stocky bunting. On breeding males, the combination of a black head, a bright yellow collar, yellow underparts, and rusty-brown back is unmistakable.

name: Green-breasted Bushshrike
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western cameroon and adjacent southeastern nigeria
description: A large, robust bushshrike with a massive head, a chunky hook-tipped black bill, and a pale eye; plumage is dull uniform olive, paler underneath, and head is gray. An uncommon resident endemic to the Cameroon-Nigeria highlands, found singly and in pairs in the canopy and at middle levels of primary hill and montane forest between 930 and 2300 meters of elevation, preferring steep slopes.

name: Tumbes Pewee
rangeDescription: Andes of western ecuador and western peru (southward to ica)
description: Small flycatcher found in dry and semi-humid forest in western Ecuador and western Peru. It is mostly gray with pale wingbars and a small crest.

name: Torresian Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: New guinea, including aru islands (off southwestern new guinea) and adjacent islands, to northern and northeastern australia
description: Large, predominantly white pigeon with black wing feathers. Tip of the tail also black.

name: Sulawesi Honey-buzzard
rangeDescription: Sulawesi region, including togian, banggai, and sula islands (off eastern sulawesi) and muna and buton (to southeast)
description: A small-headed, long-tailed raptor from Sulawesi and the Banggai Islands. Adult shows a dark crested head, a pale throat with dark central stripe, a rufous breast with bold streaking, and a barred belly.
